tools.name: retro_predict

tools.description: Apply observed C# candidates, toggle observed R# reactions, or—only in a construct-enabled experiment—stage one Agent-constructed candidate. Consider operation=construct_candidate when, relative to the active Plan and observed evidence, the available SSR candidates do not provide a sufficiently credible disconnection. Candidate-pool exhaustion is neither required nor sufficient; when a credible observed candidate fits the Plan, use or inspect it instead. For construction, propose exact precursor SMILES plus a named-reaction hypothesis and explain why the observed candidates are insufficient. The Environment does not immediately write the proposal: it runs graph invariants, executable USPTO-template replay when configured, RXNMapper and all five chemistry checks, then an additional model reviewer. Only a deterministically valid, reviewer-accepted proposal is written atomically; rejection leaves zero graph delta. Mapper success alone is not reaction-feasibility proof.

tools.name: retro_stock_check

tools.description: Submit the P-v18 route collection. The Environment keeps the session open after the first final-stock-passed route and admits at most five. When five have been collected, read retro_get_state(view=route), then provide every collected route ID exactly once in best-to-worst order with status=solved; route_ids[0] is the selected route. If executable search is exhausted before five, submit every collected route in ranked order with status=partial. With no collected route, partial or unsolved remains available. The Environment validates coverage but does not rank.
